interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Install a marked midblock crossing with a pedestrian refuge island to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to encourage slower vehicle speeds and shorten the pedestrian crossing distance.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Installing trees or large planters would create a protective buffer and improve the microclimate.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Adding curb extensions at the driveway or intersection would shorten crossing distances and slow turning traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Adding lower-height lighting fixtures would improve visibility and safety for people walking at night.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk to meet ADA standards and relocate utility poles to a furniture zone to provide a clear walking path.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-Block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island and Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB) to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to provide designated and safer crossing points.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees in the buffer zones to provide a physical barrier between pedestrians and traffic and to visually narrow the road.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees or large planters to provide a vertical buffer from the roadway and improve the aesthetic quality of the walking environment.

interventions.title: Complete Sidewalk Network
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Mark a clear crossing point with high-visibility paint and pedestrian warning signage.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow traffic and repurpose space for pedestrian safety features.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to increase the distance between pedestrians and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to facilitate safe crossing of the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Loading Zone Management
interventions.description: Designate specific off-street or inset loading bays to prevent large vehicles from obstructing sightlines or walkways.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to increase pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalks and curb extensions at the nearest intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a vertical element that naturally slows traffic and improves the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to reduce crossing distance and exposure.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstacle Removal
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk and relocate utility poles to the furniture zone to ensure a clear, accessible path of travel.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the sidewalk to provide a smooth, continuous, and ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the parking lot entrance and use vertical curbs to clearly define vehicle paths and shorten the pedestrian conflict zone.

interventions.title: Streetscape Buffer Installation
interventions.description: Add a planting strip with street trees or a furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical protection and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Add a central island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time, reducing exposure.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings and appropriate signage.

interventions.title: Marked Pedestrian Walkways

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Signage
